categories:

---

```{=html}
<section class="article-section">
  <div class="ad-page-container">
    <div class="page-section u-mb-3">
      <h1 class="section-heading">Contributor and Reviewer Guide</h1>
      <p class="page-subtitle">Four concrete paths into the project, each routed through a GitHub issue template</p>
    </div>
    <div class="articles-list">
      <aside class="provenance-note">
        <strong>Before you file.</strong> Every path below opens a public, trackable GitHub issue. Submission does not guarantee acceptance, endorsement, authorship, or a response time; proposed claims must pass the repository's evidence and review contracts described in each template.
      </aside>

      <div class="article-category">
        <h2>Propose a Correction</h2>
        <div class="article-card">
          <h3>Found a sign error, wrong equation, or missing assumption?</h3>
          <p>
            Use the <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/new?template=content-correction.md">Content Correction</a> template.
            Quote the exact claim, give the file and line, and describe how you verified it &mdash; a derivation, a script, or direct observation in both the LaTeX and Quarto trees. Corrections are held to the
            <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/blob/main/content-development/RIGOR_GUIDE.md">Rigor Guide</a>.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="article-category">
        <h2>Critique a Claim</h2>
        <div class="article-card">
          <h3>Think a mathematical or physical claim does not hold?</h3>
          <p>
            Existing objections and their status are tracked in <a href="../critiques/index.html">Critiques &amp; Responses</a>. To raise a new one or respond to an open critique, use the
            <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/new?template=critique-response.md">Critique Response</a> template: name the core argument being challenged, rate its severity, and propose the change it requires.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="article-category">
        <h2>Contribute a Dataset</h2>
        <div class="article-card">
          <h3>Have measurement data, motion-capture recordings, or a simulation dataset to share?</h3>
          <p>
            Review the existing <a href="../resources/resources-datasets.html">Datasets</a> page, then use the
            <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/new?template=resource-addition.md">Resource Addition</a> template (select <strong>Dataset</strong>) with provenance, license, and a description of what the dataset enables.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="article-category">
        <h2>Review a Chapter</h2>
        <div class="article-card">
          <h3>Willing to read a chapter or article closely and report findings?</h3>
          <p>
            Follow the repository's <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/blob/main/content-development/REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md">Content Review Protocol</a> &mdash; it defines the severity rubric and finding format reviews are held to &mdash; then file findings with the
            <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/new?template=textbook-improvement.md">Textbook Improvement</a> template. A mathematical or sign error belongs in Content Correction, above, instead.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
